questions.worked_example: Say each step out loud as you do it. Then write those steps down.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. All three steps shown clearly - multiplication, subtraction, and addition together. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: First find how many muffins are in 3 boxes of 8, then subtract that, then add the new batch.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: explaining a calculation process in writing

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Combining multiplication with addition and subtraction, and showing every step, is genuinely advanced working.

analysis.primary_construct: writing out a full reasoning process, not just a final answer
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - explaining maths in writing is a genuinely different skill from doing it.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A correct final answer with no working shown suggests confidence in mental maths outpacing willingness to write it down.
analysis.parent_note: Showing working is how you and your child can see exactly where understanding is strong or shaky.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask your child to explain out loud first, then just write down what they said.

es.instruction: Muestra cómo lo resolviste, y luego da tu respuesta.
es.prompt: Una pastelera hace 48 magdalenas. Vende 3 cajas de 8, y luego hornea 15 más. ¿Cuántas tiene ahora? Muestra tu trabajo.
hints: Primero calcula cuántas hay en 3 cajas de 8, luego resta, y luego suma.
es.worked_example: Di cada paso en voz alta mientras lo haces. Luego escribe esos pasos.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Los tres pasos mostrados con claridad: multiplicación, resta y suma juntas. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Primero averigua cuántas magdalenas hay en 3 cajas de 8, luego resta eso, y luego suma la nueva tanda.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Montre comment tu as calculé, puis donne ta réponse.
fr.prompt: Une boulangère fait 48 muffins. Elle vend 3 boîtes de 8, puis en cuit 15 de plus. Combien en a-t-elle maintenant ? Montre ton calcul.
hints: Calcule d'abord combien il y a dans 3 boîtes de 8, puis soustrais, puis additionne.
fr.worked_example: Dis chaque étape à voix haute en la faisant. Puis écris ces étapes.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Les trois étapes montrées clairement - multiplication, soustraction, et addition ensemble. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Trouve d'abord combien de muffins il y a dans 3 boîtes de 8, puis soustrais ce nombre, puis ajoute la nouvelle fournée.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Mostre como você resolveu, depois dê sua resposta.
pt.prompt: Uma padeira faz 48 muffins. Ela vende 3 caixas de 8, depois assa mais 15. Quantos ela tem agora? Mostre como você resolveu.
hints: Primeiro calcule quantos há em 3 caixas de 8, depois subtraia, depois some.
pt.worked_example: Diga cada passo em voz alta enquanto faz. Depois escreva esses passos.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Os três passos mostrados com clareza - multiplicação, subtração e soma juntos. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Primeiro descubra quantos muffins há em 3 caixas de 8, depois subtraia isso, depois some a nova fornada.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Mostra come l'hai calcolato, poi dai la tua risposta.
it.prompt: Una pasticcera fa 48 muffin. Ne vende 3 scatole da 8, poi ne cuoce altri 15. Quanti ne ha adesso? Mostra il procedimento.
hints: Prima calcola quanti ce ne sono in 3 scatole da 8, poi sottrai, poi aggiungi.
it.worked_example: Pronuncia ogni passaggio ad alta voce mentre lo fai. Poi scrivi quei passaggi.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Tutti e tre i passaggi mostrati chiaramente - moltiplicazione, sottrazione e addizione insieme. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Prima trova quanti muffin ci sono in 3 scatole da 8, poi sottrai quel numero, poi aggiungi il nuovo lotto.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Zeig, wie du es ausgerechnet hast, und gib dann deine Antwort.
de.prompt: Eine Bäckerin macht 48 Muffins. Sie verkauft 3 Schachteln mit je 8, dann backt sie 15 weitere. Wie viele hat sie jetzt? Zeig deinen Rechenweg.
hints: Rechne zuerst aus, wie viele in 3 Schachteln mit je 8 sind, dann subtrahiere, dann addiere.
de.worked_example: Sprich jeden Schritt laut aus, während du ihn machst. Schreibe diese Schritte dann auf.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Alle drei Schritte klar gezeigt – Multiplikation, Subtraktion und Addition zusammen. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Finde zuerst heraus, wie viele Muffins in 3 Schachteln mit je 8 sind, zieh das dann ab, und addiere die neue Charge.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Laat zien hoe je het hebt uitgewerkt, en geef dan je antwoord.
nl.prompt: Een bakker maakt 48 muffins. Ze verkoopt 3 dozen van 8, en bakt er dan nog 15. Hoeveel heeft ze er nu? Laat je uitwerking zien.
hints: Werk eerst uit hoeveel er in 3 dozen van 8 zitten, trek dan af, en tel dan erbij.
nl.worked_example: Zeg elke stap luid op terwijl je hem doet. Schrijf die stappen dan op.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Alle drie de stappen duidelijk getoond - vermenigvuldiging, aftrekking en optelling samen. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Zoek eerst uit hoeveel muffins er in 3 dozen van 8 zitten, trek dat dan af, en tel dan de nieuwe batch erbij.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Покажи, как ты решил, затем дай ответ.
ru.prompt: Пекарь делает 48 кексов. Она продаёт 3 коробки по 8, затем выпекает ещё 15. Сколько у неё теперь? Покажи своё решение.
hints: Сначала вычисли, сколько в 3 коробках по 8, затем вычти, затем добавь.
ru.worked_example: Произноси каждый шаг вслух, когда делаешь его. Затем запиши эти шаги.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Все три шага показаны ясно — умножение, вычитание и сложение вместе. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Сначала найди, сколько кексов в 3 коробках по 8, затем вычти это, затем добавь новую партию.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Nasıl çözdüğünü göster, sonra cevabını ver.
tr.prompt: Bir fırıncı 48 muffin yapıyor. 8'erli 3 kutu satıyor, sonra 15 muffin daha pişiriyor. Şimdi kaç tane var? Çözümünü göster.
hints: Önce 8'erli 3 kutuda kaç tane olduğunu hesapla, sonra çıkar, sonra topla.
tr.worked_example: Her adımı yaparken yüksek sesle söyle. Sonra bu adımları yaz.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Üç adım da açıkça gösterildi - çarpma, çıkarma ve toplama bir arada. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Önce 8'erli 3 kutuda kaç muffin olduğunu bul, sonra onu çıkar, sonra yeni seriyi ekle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 展示你的计算过程,然后给出答案。
zh.prompt: 一位烘焙师做了48个松饼。她卖了3盒,每盒8个,又烤了15个。她现在有多少个?展示你的计算过程。
hints: 先算出3盒8个一共多少,再减,再加。
zh.worked_example: 每做一步就大声说出来,然后把这些步骤写下来。

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39。三步都写得很清楚——乘法、减法和加法都用上了。🧁
feedback.incorrect: 先算出3盒8个松饼一共多少,再减去卖掉的,再加上新烤的那一批。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: どうやって計算したか見せて、それから答えを書こう。
ja.prompt: A baker makes 48 muffins. She sells 3 boxes of 8, then bakes 15 more. How many does she have now? Show your working.
hints: まず8個入りの箱3つに何個あるか計算して、それから引いて、それから足そう。
ja.worked_example: それぞれの段階を声に出しながらやろう。それから、その段階を書こう。

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39。3つの段階すべてがはっきり見える、かけ算、引き算、足し算を合わせた計算だね。🧁
feedback.incorrect: まず8個入りの箱3つに何個マフィンがあるか見つけて、それを引いて、それから新しいバッチを足そう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 어떻게 풀었는지 보여준 다음, 답을 쓰세요.
ko.prompt: 제빵사가 머핀 48개를 만들어요. 8개씩 든 상자 3개를 팔고, 15개를 더 구워요. 지금 몇 개가 있나요? 풀이 과정을 보여주세요.
hints: 먼저 8개씩 3상자가 몇 개인지 계산한 다음, 빼고, 더하세요.
ko.worked_example: 각 단계를 소리 내어 말해보면서 풀어보세요. 그런 다음 그 단계를 적으세요.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. 곱하기, 빼기, 더하기까지 세 단계 모두 명확히 보여줬어요. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: 먼저 8개씩 3상자가 몇 개인지 구한 다음, 그만큼 빼고, 새로 구운 양을 더하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Tunjukkan cara kamu mengerjakannya, lalu berikan jawabanmu.
id.prompt: Seorang tukang roti membuat 48 muffin. Dia menjual 3 kotak berisi 8, lalu membuat 15 lagi. Berapa yang dia punya sekarang? Tunjukkan cara kerjamu.
hints: Hitung dulu berapa isi 3 kotak berisi 8, lalu kurangi, lalu tambahkan.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan setiap langkah dengan lantang saat kamu mengerjakannya. Lalu tulis langkah-langkah itu.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Semua tiga langkah ditunjukkan dengan jelas - perkalian, pengurangan, dan penambahan sekaligus. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Hitung dulu berapa muffin dalam 3 kotak berisi 8, lalu kurangi itu, lalu tambahkan batch baru.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Trình bày cách bạn tính ra, rồi đưa ra câu trả lời.
vi.prompt: Một người làm bánh làm 48 cái muffin. Cô ấy bán 3 hộp, mỗi hộp 8 cái, rồi nướng thêm 15 cái. Hỏi hiện cô ấy có bao nhiêu cái? Hãy trình bày cách làm.
hints: Trước tiên tính có bao nhiêu trong 3 hộp, mỗi hộp 8 cái, rồi trừ, rồi cộng.
vi.worked_example: Nói to từng bước khi bạn làm. Rồi viết các bước đó ra.

feedback.correct: 48-24+15=39. Cả ba bước được trình bày rõ ràng - phép nhân, trừ và cộng cùng nhau. 🧁
feedback.incorrect: Trước tiên tìm có bao nhiêu muffin trong 3 hộp, mỗi hộp 8 cái, rồi trừ số đó, rồi cộng lượt mới.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách thực hiện nhé.
